title: You’re talking to their official AI clone.
statement: LinClone is where you talk with official AI clones of the creators you love. Their voice, their way of talking, and memories that grow every time you talk.

official.title: Official
official.body: Every clone is an official AI clone, approved by the creator.

labelled.title: Always labelled

memory.title: Your memories, your call
memory.body: See, edit or delete what their AI remembers about you, anytime.
